title: Chapter 798
text:
"A Space Displacement Esper Ability?" Han Xiao narrowed his eyes.

"You don't seem nervous at all." EsGod narrowed his eyes and suddenly realized something. His fingers exerted force and crushed the small silver cube.

He loosened his grip, and the silver alloy fragments scattered out of his palm. There was no evolution energy at all.

Seeing this, EsGod froze.

Han Xiao chuckled. "You don't think that I would really bring the Evolution Cube to see you personally, do you? I'll return your words to you … Aren't you underestimating me too much?"

This guy was not like Sisko, who had occupied the cube for many years and almost refined it into a 'magic weapon'. EsGod did not have the psychic senses of the cube to immediately check if it was real or not!

EsGod was silent for a few seconds before shaking his head. "That's right. Since you've decided to reject me, how could you bring the real thing over? I was misled by you."

When his main body had first appeared, Han Xiao had acted very tough and said that if he wanted the Evolution Cube, he could come and snatch it. This attracted EsGod's attention to the 'Evolution Cube' on him. Coupled with the fact that both sides had started fighting, EsGod had no time to think and subconsciously thought that Han Xiao had the real thing.

EsGod had just said that he was not easy to fool, but he had not expected to be tricked so quickly.

It was not a secret that the Evolution Cube had become portable. With Sisko eyeing it, it was impossible for him to hand it over to someone else for safekeeping. Han Xiao had always created this illusion, making others think that the Evolution Cube was always with him. Therefore, in EsGod's eyes, locking onto Han Xiao's whereabouts was equivalent to locking onto the location of the Evolution Cube. Because of his first impression, he had fallen into the wrong mindset and did not immediately consider the possibility of the Evolution Cube leaving Han Xiao.

The information left behind by the Evolutionary Civilization recorded the method to locate the Evolution Cube. However, it was different from Sisko's psychic senses. This method was a special detection device that was compatible with the cube and could only accurately locate it within a certain range of the Evolution Cube.

The technology of the cube detector came from countless years ago and had certain flaws compared to today. Furthermore, the technology left behind by the Evolutionary Civilization was not complete. The detector had limitations, mainly in its range. The principle was to receive a certain special energy waveband emitted by the Evolution Cube, and this waveband required time to spread across the universe. Like a ripple, it would become weaker the further away it was, which made it impossible for the detector to locate it from an infinite distance.

In the past, when EsGod stole the Evolution Cube, he first knew that the Evolution Cube was on Sisko's mother planet. After knowing the approximate location, he went to the vicinity and used detection devices to avoid Sisko's psychic shield to obtain the precise location of the Evolution Cube on his mother planet. Only then could EsGod's doppelganger use his teleportation Esper Ability to avoid the Star Pupil Protoss guards and sneak in. If they did not know where the cube was at the beginning, the detection device would not have been able to find a needle in a haystack and find the target across the vast Star Field.

The detection device was an external device, unlike Sisko's, which was an innate ability. EsGod was prejudiced, and he was held back by the three of them, so he did not check the device. Otherwise, he would have noticed the anomaly … The detection device did not detect the Evolution Cube at all.

Sisko's psychic energy was connected to the Evolution Cube. Although the location was too far away, it was an infinite distance. This was why Han Xiao usually brought the Evolution Cube with him. With a Beyond Grade A like him protecting him, it was the safest. However, it was different this time. Knowing that EsGod had many tricks up his sleeves, Han Xiao could not be unprepared. The Evolution Cube was really not with him now.

Not long ago, he had set off from Planet Crimson Ring and spent a few days to reach the border. Along the way, Han Xiao had secretly released a spaceship and split up. He did not come to the border but stealthily moved through the dynasty's territory alone. The real Evolution Cube was placed inside the spaceship, and he did not reveal this to anyone.

Sisko was far away, and the further away he was, the less accurate his senses were. He only knew that the Evolution Cube was in the general direction of the Central Galaxy. Not to mention that he did not know what was going on here, even if he knew that the Evolution Cube was separated from Han Xiao, a famous person from the Arcane Church would not be able to enter the dynasty's territory. Thus, the threat from Sisko could be ignored for the time being.

To be on the safe side, another mechanical army was stationed in the stealth spaceship that was keeping the Evolution Cube.

Because of the Emperor Mechanic's ability [Quantum Infinite Distance Transmission Channel], even if the Mech Legion was very far away from Han Xiao, they could still transmit Mechanical Force over a large area, allowing the distant Mech Legion to have the strength of a Beyond Grade A!

Staying in one place and allowing the Beyond Grade A Mech Legion to go on an expedition was the specialty and strength of a Beyond Grade A Mechanic — the Super Kiting Style.

If they were not even present, how would the enemy get close to them?

This was similar to EsGod's doppelganger, or even better. The Mecha Empire's Manison fought in this way. When fighting him, one would not even be able to see his shadow.

Han Xiao did not use this tactic at the moment because the foundation of his army could not reach the level of the Mecha Empire. Furthermore, his tankiness was his trump card, and it would be a waste if he did not use it.

However, the Mech Legion that he sent out also had the strength to crush Calamity Grades and could temporarily act as the guards for the Evolution Cube.

Various thoughts flashed through his mind, but Han Xiao did not stop. He controlled the Mech Legion to focus fire. Although EsGod's Energy Deflection Shield could block most of the energy attacks, Han Xiao had ways to deal with them.

The Mech Legion had many ways of attacking, and it was impossible for a Beyond Grade A to be helpless with just one Esper Ability. His Mech Legion could even counter the Metal Control Esper Ability, so a mere Energy Deflection Esper Ability would not be a problem for him.

Furthermore, EsGod could not use too many abilities at the same time, so it was impossible for him to only defend and not attack. Furthermore, there were two other Beyond Grade As holding him back.

One against three was not enough to deal with EsGod, but at the same time, EsGod could not easily defeat the three of them. It was impossible to determine the victor in a short time, and both sides were in a stalemate.

On the battlefield, Murraky, who had just escaped, did not have time to relax. He commanded the fleet to attack. Although he was arrogant, being able to command a Border Guard Army alone showed that his professional abilities were not for show.

Under his tactical command, the dynasty's fleet attacked crazily and steadily gained the upper hand, swallowing the enemy fleet in large mouthfuls. Without the intervention of a Beyond Grade A, this Fallen Ark fleet was not his match at all and was quickly wiped out.

EsGod frowned as he looked at the battlefield. He could see that this fleet was most likely going to be wiped out.

He had just confirmed that the Evolution Cube was not with Han Xiao, so there was no need for EsGod to continue fighting this battle. This place was too close to the dynasty's border, and reinforcements would arrive soon. Even he did not want to face the dynasty's Border Guard Army. Even if he could escape unscathed, he did not want to provoke the three Universal Civilizations.

If he killed too many of the Red Empire's troops, the Red Empire would most likely gather an army to enter the sensitive area and launch a hunt for his Fallen Ark fleet. By then, the ones who would come would be Clottey and the other two old ruffians.

Although EsGod was not afraid of them, he would lose far more than just this fleet, so it was not worth it.

At this time, Han Xiao suddenly spoke in their telepathic connection. "You have a Space Displacement Ability. You never planned to trade with me in the first place. It was just a trap, wasn't it?"

EsGod raised his hand to block Ames' force field. Hearing this, he said with a playful tone.

"I indeed don't have any credibility, but you guessed wrong this time. I was actually full of sincerity. Originally, the Evolution Cube was the only hope to reach a higher level in my eyes, but it is not now. I have seen a broader new world! To me now, the Evolution Cube is no longer my final goal. It is just a tool that I want, not something that I can't live without. If you are willing to lend it to me, I really won't do anything to you … "

A higher level? Han Xiaoxin's heart skipped a beat. EsGod had fused a Super High Risk Esper Ability and accepted countless galactic fugitives to form the Fallen Ark. Everything he did was for greater strength. His motive was very pure.

"You want to imitate the Primordial Ones, break through the limits of individual strength, and discover a new realm?" Han Xiao narrowed his eyes.

"Hehe." EsGod did not comment. Suddenly, he changed the topic and said, "Speaking of which, I still have to thank you. You let me see new hope and changed my goal."

"Thank me?" Han Xiao was confused.

"A few years ago, my doppelganger fought with you in the Shattered Star Ring and was played by you before being thrown into the wormhole," EsGod said with a strange tone. "Unfortunately, you did not go through the wormhole with me. You have no idea what you missed."

The meaning behind his words was like a blessing in disguise.

Han Xiao was stunned. Suddenly, he had a flash of inspiration and connected all the clues together. "Could it be that your people went against Harrofal because of this?"

Back then, the Dark-star leader had come back to assassinate him and used the EsGod doppelganger. That was also the first time he had crossed paths with EsGod.

At that time, he was not a match for the EsGod doppelganger. Using the surrounding wormhole environment, he cooperated with a Mechanic who studied wormholes, Harrofal, to lure the EsGod doppelganger into the wormhole and banish it.

After that, EsGod sent his subordinates to steal the Evolution Cube but killed Harrofal along the way. Han Xiao had never been clear about the reason. This matter had been over for a long time, and he did not expect EsGod to bring it up. There seemed to be more to it.

"Harrofal?" EsGod paused and seemed to think for a while before remembering this name. "Oh, that's right, that's the name. He's the guy who tricked my doppelganger with you. I got the data of that wormhole from him."

Han Xiao was shocked. EsGod said that he saw hope … What did this guy see on the other side of the wormhole?

EsGod got the data of that wormhole teleportation. Could it be that he wanted to locate the location of that random teleportation and build a stable channel?

What kind of place did that wormhole lead to that was worth EsGod making such a big fuss about it?

Han Xiaoxin was itching, but EsGod did not have the interest to continue talking. He suddenly teleported and left the three of them. With a wave of his hand, a teleportation gate opened behind him.

From far away, EsGod's gaze stabbed at Han Xiao like a knife. From his eyes, Han Xiao understood what EsGod meant.

I'll let you go this time. We'll play slowly in the future.

Their gazes collided, opposing each other harshly.

Then, EsGod took a step back and disappeared with the teleportation gate.

"He retreated …"

Han Xiao heaved a sigh of relief. Floating in the air, his expression changed. The Mech Legion lost their target and stopped moving.

Since he could not get the Evolution Cube this time, EsGod was probably going to go back and slowly plan for it. He did not know what kind of methods he would use to deal with him in the future.

The two of them had completely turned against each other this time, but this guy could not leave the Central Galaxy easily. He did not know when the next time they fought would be.

Also, the wormhole that EsGod mentioned also piqued his curiosity.

Thinking about the strength that EsGod had displayed in this battle, Han Xiao could not help but feel heavy, and the pressure on him increased.

"As expected of the final boss of the Chaotic Evil Faction. I'm still not strong enough to deal with him …"

Han Xiaoxin felt a sense of urgency. He still needed to increase his strength.
